actionableFindings.status: static supported path; DOM reproduction pending
actionableFindings.finding: Edits remain possible while async apply/export is busy. save closes over the starting svg; selected-text FigureLabelInput is not disabled by busy, and change/commit have no busy guard. Typing a label while onSave Promise waits can update local SVG after the saved snapshot. Successful onSave then closes, discarding the later local edit. PNG may similarly export starting snapshot while right-panel edits continue, though it does not close.
actionableFindings.boundedRepro: Select an existing text; start apply with deferred host Promise; type new text while pending; resolve. Assert either input is disabled/no mutation or saved snapshot and retained edits are explicitly reconciled. Repeat delayed output/PNG with same policy. Existing test only checks apply button disabled and failure retry.
actionableFindings.suggestion: Freeze all mutating controls during save/export (including MathLive) or enforce a snapshot/revision policy in the mutation/apply boundary; ensure the last pre-save MathLive flush is included before freezing. Do not silently drop input.

actionableFindings.status: static supported warning-loss path; UI reproduction pending
actionableFindings.finding: Every tab click clears warning. Entering editor calls hwpLabelToTex, which returns only converted text, so conversion warnings are discarded. A previously shown unbalanced-braces warning can disappear on editor tab entry without user fixing the value.
actionableFindings.boundedRepro: Use existing root{2 unbalanced-brace warning fixture; commit math mode then switch to editor. Also switch directly after entering warning-producing HWP text. Verify warning remains bound to the converted current value until actual edit/repair, or an explicit replacement diagnostic is shown.
actionableFindings.suggestion: Use the full HWP conversion result at tab entry and preserve warning state tied to resulting value; do not treat switching tabs or MathLive normalization as evidence that invalid input was repaired.

positiveReadOnlyChecks: Mathfield has active cleanup guard; removes input/change/blur/keydown/composition/document listeners and DOM node. idPrefix recreates field from latest value. Input/onChange refs are refreshed via layout effect.

Template insertion retains live placeholders while stripped persisted TeX excludes placeholder commands; value effect compares stripped form so a matching parent echo does not by itself erase active slots. Stored selected-label key=current.id prevents carrying one field identity across different text objects.

Outside pointer capture flushes before canvas/tab pointer actions; key/composition microtasks and blur/change supplement delayed input. This is not independent real-MathLive timing verification. Existing Mathfield tests mock a simple custom element.

Host onSave type permits Promise and save awaits it before onClose; rejection displays error, leaves modal open and clears busy for retry. PNG handler never invokes onSave/onClose, uses rendered data URL to PNG and reports failures separately.

Clipboard write is caught before cut removal; stale page-local token displays error; explicit notice says same-page paste. External SVG/text fallback still goes through paste preparation. Original numbering/URL rewrite implementation is retained.
residualLimits: Unmount cleanup deliberately cancels queued input without a final flush. Pointer tab changes have capture flush, but programmatic/keyboard identity changes with a pending delayed input need a dedicated test; no actual lost keystroke claimed from static inspection.

Single-slot opaque clipboard invalidates previous tokens when a later copy replaces memory, and cannot restore after reload/cross-tab. A synchronous setData failure avoids cut deletion but can already replace memory token and clear OS clipboard data. Silent MIME refusal is not validated by current code; no actual browser failure reproduced.
No host callsite persistence/transaction or navigation-abort guarantee beyond inspected shared onSave contract; no broad SSR/MathLive/font/layout approval.
